name: Slideshow
description: Show photos you made with your phone to friends you invited.
Launch this board on a device with a big screen, a TV for example.
Scan the QR code on the bottom with the phone and inject photos you want to show from there.
Once you see photos arriving, make sure to switch the canvas service into fullscreen by double clicking

name: Game
description: Use your phone as an input controller for a simple game.
The game is devided into three runtimes: input, logic and output.
Initially all three runtimes are on the same board.
Connect your phone as an input by scanning the QR code on the bottom, then inject movement events.

name: Reflector Sender
description: Ingest data towards the public reflector, passing data along with a topic.

name: Reflector Receiver
description: Subscribe to topics that are returned by the public reflector.

name: Multiplication Practise
description: Learning multiplication rows for elementary school
